subject: Social Media
title: The Future of Truth
description: A 60-second lesson on The Future of Truth.

hook.text: AI can now write a fake news article in seconds. It can also detect fake news in seconds. The arms race accelerates.

buildup.text: Blockchain verification could timestamp content at creation. If you can prove origin, you can prove authenticity.

discovery.text: Coalition for Content Provenance aims to embed origin data in every photo and video. Fakes would lack the signature.

twist.text: But technical solutions need adoption. If only trusted media uses provenance, fakers won't. Trust asymmetry remains.

climax.text: Truth may become a premium product: verified, sourced, and expensive. Lies will remain free. The market favors lies.

punchline.text: In the future, truth might cost more than fiction.

quiz.question: What does content provenance technology aim to prove?
options: The origin and authenticity of media
